memory: I found the 6.00 mm dowelled flange + 0.25 mm PTFE reduced but did not eliminate microslip. A 0.25 mm neoprene full-face gasket removes flange-seat microslip up to ~1.5 N preload, but adds compliance, hysteresis, and creep, and extrudes past ~1.6 N. Current goal: eliminate microslip while preserving flange stiffness and independent energy control.
openQuestion: If I place a thin rigid backing ring over the neoprene gasket to limit compression, will slip suppression remain while restoring flange stiffness and energy independence?
